repository.description: Canonical path of the routed repository.

index.description: The published code-graph index that answered.

revision.description: Commit the index was built at; null on an unborn branch.

checkout_revision.description: Current checkout commit; null when HEAD is unborn or unreadable.

fresh.description: True when the index was built at checkout_revision. When false, results describe older code and stale names the fix.

worktree_dirty.description: Whether uncommitted changes were indexed along with revision.

synced_at.description: When the index was published (RFC 3339, UTC).

stale.description: Present when fresh is false: why, and the call that refreshes the index.

fix.description: The maintenance call to run, then retry the query.

tool.description: Tool to call: orbit.graph.maintain, or graph.maintain for a non-first-party install.

result.description: The orbit-graph library result, passed through unshaped (it may gain fields): DepsResult: scope and imports (from_file, target_path, optional target_symbol).

truncated.description: True when any result array, at any depth, was cut to limit or to fit the 256 KiB response ceiling (limit is halved until the result fits).

truncation.description: Present only when truncated is true. Keyed by field path, with [] for each entry of an array (files[].symbols, fallback.touched): {returned, total}, where a nested path sums over the returned parent entries.
